```{r "Quantilisation"}
names(all_data) = gsub('_pau*v*', '_poor', names(all_data) )
variables = c('men_poor','men_non_poor','p_poor', 'ind_65','p_65', 'ind_14','p_14', 'ind', 'hmi',  'retention', 'rec_decay', 'nv_per_ind')
names = c('q_poor','q_p_poor',  'q_65','q_p_65', 'q_14','q_p_14', 'q_prop', 'q_ind', 'q_hmi', 'q_retention', 'q_rec_decay', 'q_nv_per_ind')

cut_quant = function(x, probs = c(0, 0.33, 0.66 ,1)){
  as.numeric(cut(x, quantile(x, probs,na.rm = T),  include.lowest = TRUE))
}

for (v in 1:length(variables)){
  print(variables[v])
  var = as.numeric(values(all_data[, variables[v]])[,1])
  all_data[, names[v]] = cut_quant(var)
}

all_data$is.low_nv = ifelse(all_data$nv_per_ind<median(all_data$nv_per_ind), 'low_nv', 'high_nv')

# Number of poorly provided ES
all_data$n_q1 = as.numeric(all_data$q_retention == 1) + as.numeric(all_data$q_hmi == 1) + as.numeric(all_data$q_rec_decay == 1)

data_socio = as.data.frame(all_data)
all_data = crop(all_data, all_data[!(is.nan(all_data$rec_decay)),])
all_data_spatpoly <- as(all_data, "Spatial")
```

```{r 1. Plot map figures}
plot_map = function(all_spatial_data,
                          var_soc = NA, 
                          var_es = NA,
                          data_name,
                          submap_ext,
                          my_breaks = NA,
                          savefile = NA){

    #from https://upgo.lab.mcgill.ca/2019/12/13/making-beautiful-maps/
type = ifelse(class(all_spatial_data) ==  "SpatVector",  "vector", "raster")
data_type = ifelse(!is.na(var_soc) & !is.na(var_es), 'quantiles', 'continuous')

if (type == 'raster'){   
  print('raster')
data = all_spatial_data[[ var_es ]]
names(data) = 'var'
limits = minmax(data)[,1]}

if (type == 'vector'){
    print('vector')
  if (data_type == 'continuous'){
        print('continuous')
data = all_spatial_data[ var_soc ]
names(data) = 'var'
limits = c(min(data), max(data))}
  
  if (data_type == 'quantiles'){
    print('quantile')
  data = all_spatial_data
  print(var_soc)
  print(var_es)
  data[, 'var_soc' ] = data[ ,var_soc ]
  data[, 'var_es' ] = data[ ,var_es ]

    # Create combined vector
  data$var = 10*data$var_es + data$var_soc
  data$var = as.factor(  data$var)
  }
}

main_map = ggplot() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA),
            legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.85, .28),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.1, 'cm'),
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.title.position = 'top',
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_blank()) +
  geom_spatraster(data = mnt, aes(fill = DEM_ISERE) ) +
  scale_fill_distiller(type = "seq",
                        direction = 1,
                        palette = "Greys", name = 'Elevation (m)',
                       trans = 'log10', guide = 'none') +
    new_scale_fill()# +
#   ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(
#   location = "tr", which_north = "true",
#   pad_x = unit(0.5, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.25, "in"),
#   style = ggspatial::north_arrow_nautical(
#     fill = c("grey40", "white"),
#     line_col = "grey20")) +
# ggspatial::annotation_scale(
#   location = "tr",
#   bar_cols = c("grey60", "white")
# )
  
subdata = crop(data, ext(submap_ext))
submap =  ggplot() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA),
            legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.position = 'none',
    axis.text.x=element_blank(), 
      axis.ticks.x=element_blank(), 
      axis.text.y=element_blank(), 
      axis.ticks.y=element_blank())

if (type == 'raster'){ 
main_map = main_map + 
 geom_spatraster(data = data, aes(fill = var) ) +
  scale_fill_continuous(option = 'B',type = "viridis", na.value = "transparent", name = data_name,
                        limits = limits)

submap = submap + geom_spatraster(data = subdata, aes(fill = var) ) +
  scale_fill_continuous(option = 'B',type = "viridis", na.value = "white", name = data_name,
                        limits = limits)
}

if (type == 'vector' & data_type == 'continuous'){ 
main_map = main_map + geom_spatvector(data = data) +
  aes(color = var, fill = var) +
  scale_fill_continuous(option = 'B',type = "viridis", na.value = "transparent", name = data_name,
                        limits = limits, trans = "sqrt", breaks = my_breaks)+
  scale_color_continuous(option = 'B',type = "viridis", na.value = "transparent", name = data_name,
                        limits = limits, trans = "sqrt", breaks = my_breaks)

submap = submap + geom_spatvector(data = subdata) +
  aes(color = var, fill = var) +
  scale_fill_continuous(option = 'B',type = "viridis", na.value = "transparent", name = data_name,
                        limits = limits, trans = "sqrt", breaks = my_breaks)+
  scale_color_continuous(option = 'B',type = "viridis", na.value = "transparent", name = data_name,
                        limits = limits, trans = "sqrt", breaks = my_breaks)
}

if (type == 'vector' & data_type == 'quantiles'){ 
main_map = main_map +   geom_spatvector(data = data) +
  aes(color = var, fill = var) +
 scale_colour_manual(values = c( "lightgoldenrod1","goldenrod1","darkorange3",
                                 "lightskyblue1","burlywood","tan4",
                                 "steelblue2","#4A618C","navyblue"),guide = 'none') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( "lightgoldenrod1","goldenrod1","darkorange3",
                                 "lightskyblue1","burlywood","tan4",
                                 "steelblue2","#4A618C","navyblue"),guide = 'none') 
#c("#FFFFFF","#EFD67E","#EC9F40",
#                                 "#D6E6F8","#D7C190","#836838",
#                                 "#6E9DD4","#26425C","#000000")

submap = submap + geom_spatvector(data = subdata) +
  aes(color = var, fill = var) +
 scale_colour_manual(values = c( "lightgoldenrod1","goldenrod1","darkorange3",
                                 "lightskyblue1","burlywood","tan4",
                                 "steelblue2","#4A618C","navyblue")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( "lightgoldenrod1","goldenrod1","darkorange3",
                                 "lightskyblue1","burlywood","tan4",
                                 "steelblue2","#4A618C","navyblue"))
}

main_map = main_map +
  geom_spatvector(data = crop(cities, data), shape = 21, colour = 'white',fill = 'darkred', inherit.aes = F) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE,
          xlim = c(889900, 932560),
          ylim = c(6437456, 6480852))+
  annotate("rect",
    xmin = submap_ext[1],
    ymin = submap_ext[3],
    xmax = submap_ext[2],
    ymax = submap_ext[4],
    fill = NA, 
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  )

if (data_type != 'quantiles'){ 
main_map = main_map +
  annotate("rect",
    xmin = 925560,
    ymin = -Inf,
    xmax = +Inf,
    ymax = 6450000,
    fill = 'white', 
    colour = 'black',
    linewidth = 0.5)}

submap = submap + geom_spatvector(data = crop(cities, subdata), size = 3, shape = 21, colour = 'white',fill = 'darkred', inherit.aes = F)  + coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  annotate("rect",
    xmin = submap_ext[1],
    ymin = submap_ext[3],
    xmax = submap_ext[2],
    ymax = submap_ext[4],
    fill = NA, 
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 1.5
  )+ labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_nothing() 

plot = ggdraw(main_map) +
  draw_plot(
    {
      submap + theme( panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))
      },
    # The distance along a (0,1) x-axis to draw the left edge of the plot
    x = 0.09, 
    # The distance along a (0,1) y-axis to draw the bottom edge of the plot
    y = 0.06,
    # The width and height of the plot expressed as proportion of the entire ggdraw object
    width = 0.36, 
    height = 0.36)

if (!is.na(savefile)){
  ggsave(plot = plot, savefile, width = 7)
}
return(plot)
}
```

```{r 2.1 Check distributions between poor and non-poor households}
all_data_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(all_data)
all_data_sf$id = 1:nrow(all_data_sf)

# Reorganise data into long format
data_poor = all_data_sf[,c('id', 'men_poor','hmi', 'retention', 'rec_decay','q_hmi', 'q_retention','q_rec_decay', 'n_q1')]
names(data_poor) = c('id',  'weights', 'hmi','retention',  'rec_decay','q_hmi', 'q_retention','q_rec_decay', 'n_q1',  "geometry" )
data_poor$is.poor = 'poor'

data_non_poor = all_data_sf[,c('id',  'men_non_poor','hmi',  'retention', 'rec_decay', 'q_hmi', 'q_retention','q_rec_decay', 'n_q1')]
names(data_non_poor) = c('id',  'weights', 'hmi','retention', 'rec_decay','q_hmi', 'q_retention','q_rec_decay', 'n_q1', "geometry" )
data_non_poor$is.poor = 'non_poor'

data_split = as.data.table(rbind(data_poor,data_non_poor))

data_long = melt(data_split, id.vars = c('id', 'weights', 'is.poor'), variable.name = 'ES', measure.vars = c('hmi', 'retention', 'green_quan','rec_decay')) 
data_long[, ES_var_pretty := recode_factor(ES, "hmi"       = 'a. Heat mitigation',
                                               "retention"  = 'b. Flood mitigation',
                                               'rec_decay' = "c. Recreation",
                                               "green_quan" = 'Amount of vegetation')]

data_long = data_long[ES %in% c('hmi', 'retention','rec_decay'),]
data_rep = data_long
data_rep$ID = 1:nrow(data_rep)
data_rep = data_rep[rep(1:.N,round(weights, 0))][,Indx:=1:.N,by=ID]
data_rep$is.poor = as.factor(data_rep$is.poor)

# Get averages
values = data_long[, list(wt.mean =  wtd.mean(value, weights),
                          wt.median =  weighted.median(value, weights)), by =list(ES_var_pretty, is.poor)
                          ]

# Get bootstrap confidence intervals
boot_weight_mean = function(data, i){
  d = data[i,]
  wtd.mean(d$value, d$weights)}
data_long[,  boot.ci(boot(.SD,boot_weight_mean, R = 999), type = 'bca')$bca[4:5], .SDcols = c('value', 'weights'), by = c('ES', 'is.poor') ]

#tests_diff = data_long[,  list(p_mean = kruskal_wallis_test(.SD, 'value', by = 'is.poor', weights = 'weights')$p), by = ES_var_pretty]

#tests_diff[, p_mean := as.character(ifelse(p_mean< 0.001, 'p < 0.001', paste0('p = ',round(p_mean, 3))))]


# Values to print on figure
values_test = #merge(
  dcast(values, ES_var_pretty~is.poor, value.var = 'wt.mean')#, tests_diff, by = 'ES_var_pretty')
values_test[, label := paste0('Secure: ', round(non_poor, 2), "\nPoor: ",round(poor, 2))]
                              #,'\n',p_mean)]
values_test[, c('x', 'y') := list(c('right', 'right', 'right'#, 'right', 'right'
                                    ),
                                  c(rep('top', 3)))#5)))
                                  ]
# Figure 3 a-c
density_plot = ggplot(data_long, aes(x = value, weight = weights, fill = is.poor)) + theme_bw() +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ES_var_pretty, scales = 'free') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = 'B', begin = 0.2, end = 0.8, name = 'Group',
                       breaks = c('non_poor', 'poor'), labels = c('Secure households', 'Poor households')) + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = 'B', begin = 0.2, end = 0.8, name = '',  guide = F) +
  geom_vline(data = values, aes(xintercept = wt.mean, colour = is.poor)) +
  geom_text_npc(data = values_test, aes(npcx = x, npcy = y, label = label), inherit.aes = F,size = 4) +
  ylab('Density') + xlab('Ecosystem service value') +
   theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_textbox(
      size = 12,
      color = "white", fill = "#5D729D", box.color = "#4A618C",
      halign = 0.5, linetype = 1, r = unit(5, "pt"), width = unit(1, "npc"),
      padding = margin(2, 0, 1, 0), margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    ),
    legend.position = 'bottom'
  )
density_plot
ggsave(plot = density_plot, 'Figures/density_plot.jpg', width = 9, height = 4)
```

``` {r 2.2 Regressions of ES ~ eco var with spatial autocorrelation}
# Supplementary analysis
centers = st_centroid(all_data_sf)
centers_xy = st_coordinates(centers)
all_data_sf$X = centers_xy[, 1]
all_data_sf$Y = centers_xy[, 2]

all_data_sf = st_as_sf(data.frame(all_data_sf), coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = crs(all_data_sf))

# Model with spatial error, on RANK data
nb <- dnearneigh(all_data_sf, d1 = 100, d2 = 250)
listw <- spdep::nb2listw(nb, style="W",zero.policy = TRUE)
rerun = F
if (rerun == T){
list_mods_spatcorr = list()
results_spatcorr = setDT(expand.grid('ES' = c('hmi','retention', 'rec_decay'), 'Soc' = c('p_poor', 'nv_per_ind_k')))
for (x in c('hmi', 'retention', 'rec_decay')){
  for (y in c('p_poor', 'nv_per_ind_k')){
    if (y == 'p_poor'){data = all_data_sf[, c(x, y, 'men')]}
    if (y == 'nv_per_ind_k'){data = all_data_sf[, c(x, y, 'ind')]}

    names(data)[1:3] = c('x', 'y', 'men')
    
    data$rank_x = order(data$x)
    data$rank_y = order(data$y)

    serr_p <- spatialreg::errorsarlm(rank_x ~ rank_y,
                               data = data,
                               listw = listw,
                               zero.policy = TRUE, 
                               na.action = na.omit,
                               weights = men)
 
  a = list(serr_p)
  names(a) = paste0(x, y)
  list_mods_spatcorr = c(list_mods_spatcorr, a)
  
  s = summary(serr_p)
  results_spatcorr[ES == x & Soc ==y, c('Estimate', 'SE', 'P') := as.list(s$Coef[2, c(1, 2, 4)])]
  }
  
results_spatcorr[, Estimate := round(Estimate, 4)]
results_spatcorr[, SE := round(SE, 4)]
  
fwrite(results_spatcorr, 'Results/results_spatcorr.csv')
}
}
results_spatcorr =fread( 'Results/results_spatcorr.csv')
```

```{r 2.3 Accumulation of low ES}
setDT(data_socio)

#### Number of ES poorly provided in poor or non-poor households
# Proportion of poor/non-poor households in areas with at least two poorly provided ES
prop.test(c(sum(data_socio[data_socio$n_q1>=2, ]$men_poor, na.rm = T),
           sum(data_socio[data_socio$n_q1>=2, ]$men_non_poor, na.rm = T)),
            c(sum(data_socio$men_poor, na.rm = T),
              sum(data_socio$men_non_poor, na.rm = T)),
          p = NULL, 
          alternative = "two.sided", 
          correct = TRUE)

### Spatial regression: difference living standard per number of services poorly provided
all_data_sf$lowEs_2_more = all_data_sf$n_q1>=2

serr_p <- spatialreg::errorsarlm(nv_per_ind_k ~ lowEs_2_more,
                               data = all_data_sf,
                               listw = listw,
                               zero.policy = TRUE, 
                               na.action = na.omit,
                               weights = men)
summary(serr_p)
```
